Megan Quigley

I want to make it easier for people to get the support they need. Studying sociology at Lehigh University got me thinking about how institutions shape everyday life. Working on financial wellness benefits at Lincoln Financial and helping employees navigate policies and benefits at NBCUniversal made those questions concrete: what keeps people from using the support available to them, and how can we make the process better?

That question drives my research and writing. I use public data and visual stories to explain how benefits work, where people get stuck, and what could help. My mission is to help turn the promise of support into something people can actually use. Away from these projects, I’m exploring restaurants through Beli, solving the NYT Mini, or looking for my next read on Libby.
